senses.definition: n.[m.] 1. outstretching; 2. place of letting loose:—מ׳ only cstr.:
בְּכָל־מ׳ יַד פ׳ in every outstretching of one’s hand, = every understaking, Dt 12:7, 18; 15:10; 23:21; 28:8, 20.
לְמ׳ שׁוֹר וּלְמִרְמֶס שֶׂה Is 7:25 (√ Pi. 3 especially Is 32:20).
